actual_source_atom.admission_proof: for every prime p>=5, 2*log(p)>sqrt(5*log(p)), hence p^5*exp(-sqrt(5*log(p)))>p^3; all n_j=p^(1,2,3,2)<=N
actual_source_atom.coefficient_product: +(log(p))^4/(a_phi(T)^4*L^4*p^4), positive for all sufficiently large T since a_phi(T)->1
actual_source_atom.filters: R=400; J_v=[max(0,-v),min(1,1-v)] for |v|<1; all four intervals are nonempty
actual_source_atom.selected_section: I=[k_minus,k_plus], m=|I|>=d-2q, d=floor(TL/(2*pi)), q=floor(d/sqrt(L)); therefore m>=10 for all sufficiently large p, uniformly in the selected endpoints

row_factor_relations.definition: for each ordered partition pi, t_pi(v)=(-1)^(|pi|-1)*product_(B in pi) D_m(sum_(j in B) v_j)
row_factor_relations.not_a_common_nonnegative_factor_globally: D_m block products differ by partition and may be signed/complex away from closure; the common tuple coefficient is not globally nonnegative after carrier and filtered overlap

source_basis.fourth_order_definition: finite empirical row cumulant of actual hard-band filtered prime matrix; see WP84_R400_FILTERED_CONNECTED_KERNEL.md §§1-3
source_basis.selected_section_mask: k in I=[k_minus,k_plus], m=|I|; row averages D_m; selected endpoints common to terms
source_basis.source_mask: 1_{n_j is a prime power <=N} times 1_{epsilon_j in {+1,-1}}; common to all 26 partitions; no fifth-order callback is used

source_operator_and_admission.alias_conditions: physical alias variable S=sum_j epsilon_j*log(n_j)/L; exact row aliases are S in Z and near-alias windows have width O(1/(T*L)); no alias or non-pair term is deleted in the full aggregate
source_operator_and_admission.conjugation: for nonclosed S, use the common midpoint phase exp(pi*i*(m-1)*S) and centered real Dirichlet factors; the kernel may be complex; on S=0 each term is real
source_operator_and_admission.hard_band_cutoff: R=400; closed row-index paths have r_j in [-400,400], sum r_j=0; source note count=342615201 paths
source_operator_and_admission.overlap_fourier_phase: sum_(|r_j|<=400,sum r_j=0) product_j a_r(v_j)*exp(2*pi*i*sum_j r_j*p_j), a_r(v)=integral_(J_v) exp(-2*pi*i*r*x) dx
source_operator_and_admission.section_selection: I=[k_minus,k_plus] common; m=|I|>=d-2q, q=floor(d/sqrt(L)); selection is by the shared endpoint-score rule
source_operator_and_admission.sign_domain: epsilon_j in {-1,+1}; v_j=epsilon_j*log(n_j)/L; all 16 sign words retained; balanced sector has 6 two-positive/two-negative placements
source_operator_and_admission.source_carrier: exp(i*T*L*S)*exp(2*pi*i*k_minus*S), common to all 26 terms; equals 1 on S=0
source_operator_and_admission.source_selection_scope: the row selector is the common selected section from the fixed-band endpoint-score construction; no termwise section or diagnostic prime pool is substituted

witness_cone.evaluated_source_vector: e_1 (first one-block coordinate is +1; other 25 coordinates vanish) at m=10
witness_cone.nonpositive_multiplier_cone: {u in R^26 : u_1<=0}; no vector with every u_j>0 belongs

zero_margin_test.classification: exact finite-grid zero-margin diagnostic; not used as the legal positive source atom
zero_margin_test.reweighting: multiply first nonzero term by 1+delta and keep the second at 1; bracket=delta, so either sign occurs arbitrarily near delta=0
